surah_info.name_meaning: Al-Baqarah ka matlab hai 'The Cow' ya 'The Heifer'. Ye naam surah ke andar aane wale ek waqiye se liya gaya hai jisme Bani Israel ko ek gaay zibah karne ka hukum diya gaya tha (ayat 67-73).
surah_info.introduction: Surah Al-Baqarah Quran ki sab se lambi surah hai aur ye Madinah mein nazil hui. Isme 286 ayat hain aur ye Quran ke pehle teen juz mein phaili hui hai. Ye surah Hijrat ke baad Madinah ki nayi Muslim community ke liye ek mukammal rehnumai ka document hai — isme aqeedah, ibadah, muamlat, aur social laws sab shamil hain.
surah_info.what: Ye surah ek comprehensive guidance hai jo iman, kufr, nifaq (hypocrisy), Bani Israel ki history, Ibrahim (AS) ki qurbani, Qibla ki tabdeeli, aur Muslim ummah ke liye ahkam (laws) par mushtamil hai. Isme pehle 20 ayat mein teen groups ka taaruf karaya gaya hai — momin, kafir, aur munafiq.
surah_info.why: Ye surah Muslim ummah ko batati hai ke Quran ki hidayat kis tarah kaam karti hai aur logon ke different responses kya hote hain. Pehle 20 ayat mein Allah ne teen groups ki tashreeh ki hai taake Muslim community apne aas paas ke logon ko pehchaan sake aur unse deal karne ka tareeqa seekh sake.
surah_info.when_where: Ye surah Madinah mein Hijrat ke pehle do saalon mein nazil hui. Kuch riwayat ke mutabiq ye pehli surah hai jo Madinah mein mukammal taur par nazil hui. Iska waqt wo tha jab Nabi ﷺ aur sahaba Makkah se Madinah hijrat kar chuke the aur ek nayi multi-religious society mein Islam ki bunyad rakh rahe the.
surah_info.how_to_study: Is surah ko padhte waqt khud ko Madinah ki pehli Muslim community mein samjho. Aap naye naye Madinah aaye ho — aapke saamne mukhtalif log hain: kuch sachche momin, kuch sakht mukhalif, aur kuch aise jo do rukhon wale hain. Quran aapko batata hai ke in teen groups ko kaise pehchano aur unse kaise deal karo.
surah_info.known_vs_debated: Known: Surah ki 286 ayat hain, ye Madani hai, aur ye Quran ki sab se lambi surah hai. Debated: Alif Lam Mim jaise huruf muqatta'at (disjointed letters) ka matlab kya hai — kuch scholars kehte hain ye Allah ke ilm mein hai, kuch kehte hain ye Arabi zaban ke letters hain jo Quran ki inimitability (i'jaz) ko dikhate hain.
themes: Bani Israel ki history aur unke sabaq
surah_info.central_message: Quran ek hidayat hai un logon ke liye jo taqwa (Allah ka khauf aur uski raza ki talash) rakhte hain. Log Quran ke saamne teen tarah ka response dete hain — iman, inkar, ya nifaq. Insan ko apna response chunna hai aur apne dil ki haqeeqat pehchanni hai.
surah_info.significance: Ye Quran ki sab se lambi surah hai aur isme sab se zyada ahkam (laws) hain. Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Aayatein al-Kursi Quran ki sab se azeem ayat hai.' Iske aakhri do ayat (2:285-286) bahut fazilat wale hain — Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya ke jo inhein raat ko padhe, wo uske liye kafi hain. Is surah ko padhne se ghar se shaitan bhagta hai.
surah_info.revelation_context: Hijrat ke baad Madinah mein nazil hui. Is waqt Madinah mein teen ahem groups the — Muhajireen (Makkah se aaye hue Muslims), Ansar (Madinah ke Muslims), aur Munafiqeen (naye naye Muslim banne ka dawa karne wale lekin dil se kafir). Iske ilawa Bani Israel ke qabilay bhi the jo Islam ke mukhalif the. Is surah ka ek bara hissa Bani Israel ko addressed hai aur unki history se sabaq diya gaya hai.

ayahs.arabic: الٓمٓ
ayahs.transliteration: Alif-Laaam-Meeem
ayahs.roman_urdu: Alif Laam Mim.
ayahs.english_meaning: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًۭى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Zaalikal-Kitaabu laa raiba feeh; hudal-lil-muttaqeen
ayahs.roman_urdu: Ye woh kitab hai jisme koi shak nahi, hidayat hai un logon ke liye jo taqwa rakhte hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena yu'minoona bil-ghaibi wa yuqeemoonas-salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Jo ghaib par iman laate hain, namaz qaim karte hain, aur jo kuch humne unhein diya usme se kharch karte hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena yu'minoona bimaaa unzila ilaika wa maaa unzila min qablika wa bil-Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur jo iman laate hain uspar jo tum par nazil kiya gaya aur jo tum se pehle nazil kiya gaya, aur Akhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: And who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa ulaaa'ika humul-muflihoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Ye log apne Rabb ki taraf se hidayat par hain, aur yehi kamiyab hone wale hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: Those are upon guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-lazeena kafaroo sawaaa'un 'alaihim a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Beshak jin logon ne kufr kiya, unke liye barabar hai — chahe tum unhein darao ya na darao, wo iman nahi laayenge.
ayahs.english_meaning: Indeed, those who disbelieve — it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them — they will not believe.

ayahs.arabic: خَتَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ ۖ وَعَلَىٰٓ أَبْصَٰرِهِمْ غِشَٰوَةٌۭ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
ayahs.transliteration: Khatamal-laahu 'alaa quloobihim wa 'alaa sam'i-him wa 'alaaa absaarihim ghishaawatunw wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.roman_urdu: Allah ne unke dilon par aur kaanon par mohar laga di hai, aur unki aankhon par parda hai, aur unke liye bada azab hai.
ayahs.english_meaning: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَبِٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ وَمَا هُم بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa minan-naasi man yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi wa bil-Yawmil-Aakhiri wa maa hum bimu'mineen
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur logon mein se kuch aise hain jo kehte hain: hum Allah par aur Akhirat ke din par iman laaye, halanki wo momin nahi hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: And of the people are some who say, 'We believe in Allah and the Last Day,' but they are not believers.

ayahs.arabic: يُخَٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Yukhaadi'oonal-laaha wal-lazeena aamanoo wa maa yakhda'oona illaaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Wo Allah aur momino ko dhoka dene ki koshish karte hain, lekin dar-asal apne aap ko dhoka de rahe hain, aur unhein iska shuoor nahi.
ayahs.english_meaning: They try to deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive none but themselves, and they do not perceive.

ayahs.arabic: فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ فَزَادَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَرَضًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْذِبُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Fee quloobihim maradun fa-zaadahumul-laahu maradan wa lahum 'azaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakziboon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Unke dilon mein bimari hai, Allah ne unki bimari aur badha di, aur unke liye dardnak azab hai kyunki wo jhoot bolte the.
ayahs.english_meaning: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they used to lie.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا تُفْسِدُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil-ardi qaaloo innamaa nahnu muslihoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur jab unse kaha jata hai ke zameen par fasaad na phailao, to kehte hain: hum to sirf islaah karne wale hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: And when it is said to them, 'Do not cause corruption on the earth,' they say, 'We are but reformers.'

ayahs.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْسِدُونَ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Alaaa innahum humul-mufsidoona wa laakin laa yash'uroon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Suno! Beshak yehi log fasaad phailane wale hain, lekin unhein shuoor nahi.
ayahs.english_meaning: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive it not.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ ءَامِنُوا۟ كَمَآ ءَامَنَ ٱلنَّاسُ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَآ آمَنَ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلسُّفَهَآءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa qeela lahum aaminoo kamaa aamanan-naasu qaaloo anu'minu kamaa aamanas-sufahaaa'u alaaa innahum humus-sufahaaa'u wa laakin laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur jab unse kaha jata hai ke iman lao jaise log iman laaye, to kehte hain: kya hum iman laayen jaise bewaqoof iman laaye? Suno! Beshak yehi bewaqoof hain, lekin wo jaante nahi.
ayahs.english_meaning: And when it is said to them, 'Believe as the people have believed,' they say, 'Should we believe as the foolish have believed?' Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know it not.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا لَقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ شَيَٰطِينِهِمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مَعَكُمْ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ مُسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Wa izaa laqul-lazeena aamanoo qaaloo aamannaa wa izaa khalaw ilaa shayaateenihim qaaloo innaa ma'akum innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur jab momino se milte hain to kehte hain: hum iman laaye. Aur jab apne shaitanon ke saath tanhai mein hote hain to kehte hain: hum tumhare saath hain, hum to sirf mazaak kar rahe the.
ayahs.english_meaning: And when they meet those who believe, they say, 'We believe'; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, 'Indeed, we are with you; we were only mocking.'

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu yastahzi'u bihim wa yamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Allah unse mazaak karta hai aur unhein unki sarkashi mein bhatakne deta hai.
ayahs.english_meaning: Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشْتَرَوُا۟ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Ulaaa'ikal-lazeenash-tarawud-dalaalata bil-hudaa famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen
ayahs.roman_urdu: Ye woh log hain jinhone hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareedi, to unki tijarat ne koi faida nahi diya, aur wo hidayat yafta nahi hue.
ayahs.english_meaning: Those are the ones who have purchased error for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

ayahs.arabic: مَثَلُهُمْ كَمَثَلِ ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًۭا فَلَمَّآ أَضَآءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهُۥ ذَهَبَ ٱللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ لَّا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Masaluhum kamasalil-lazeestawqada naaran falammaaa adaa'at maa hawlahoo zahabaal-laahu binoorihim wa tarakahum fee zulumaatil-laa yubsiroon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Unki misaal us shakhs ki si hai jisne aag jalayi, phir jab usne uske aas paas ko roshan kiya, Allah ne unki roshni cheen li aur unhein andheron mein chhor diya jahan wo kuch nahi dekhte.
ayahs.english_meaning: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, and when it illuminated all around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darknesses, so they could not see.

ayahs.arabic: صُمٌّۢ بُكْمٌ عُمْىٌ فَهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.transliteration: Summum bukmun 'umyun fahum laa yarji'oon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Behre hain, gonge hain, andhe hain, pas wo laut nahi sakte.
ayahs.english_meaning: Deaf, dumb, and blind, so they will not return.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌۭ وَرَعْدٌۭ وَبَرْقٌۭ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.transliteration: Aw kasayyibim minas-samaaa'i feehi zulumaatunw wa ra'dunw wa barq; yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim minas-sawaa'iqi hazaral-mawt; wallaahu muheetum bil-kaafireen
ayahs.roman_urdu: Ya jaise aasman se barish, jisme andhere hain, bijli aur kadak hai; wo maut ke darr se apni ungliyan apne kaanon mein daal lete hain kadak ki wajah se; aur Allah kafiron ko gherne wala hai.
ayahs.english_meaning: Or like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder, and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

ayahs.arabic: يَكَادُ ٱلْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَٰرَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَضَآءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا۟ فِيهِ وَإِذَآ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا۟ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.transliteration: Yakaadul-barqu yakhtafu absaarahum kullamaaa adaa'a lahum mashaw feehi wa izaaa azlama 'alaihim qaamoo; wa law shaaa'al-laahu lazahaba bisam'ihim wa absaarihim; innal-laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
ayahs.roman_urdu: Kareeb hai ke bijli unki aankhon ko cheen le. Jab bhi unke liye roshni hoti hai, usme chalte hain, aur jab andhera ho jata hai, to khade reh jaate hain. Aur agar Allah chahta to unke kaan aur aankhein le jaata. Beshak Allah har cheez par qadir hai.
ayahs.english_meaning: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights the way for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand still. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

sections.title: Mominon ki Sifaat
sections.theme: Quran ki hidayat aur sachche mominon ki pehchaan.
sections.flow: Pehle huruf muqatta'at (Alif Lam Mim), phir Quran ki azmat, phir mominon ki 5 sifaat, phir unka inaam.
sections.summary: Ye hissa Quran ka taaruf hai. Alif Lam Mim ke baad bataya gaya hai ke ye kitab bilkul shak se pak hai aur ye taqwa walon ke liye hidayat hai. Phir mominon ki 5 khasusiyat batayi gayi hain: ghaib par iman, namaz qaim karna, Allah ke diye hue rizq se kharch karna, Quran aur pichhli kitabon par iman, aur Akhirat par yaqeen. Inka inaam hai hidayat aur kamiyabi.
sections.study_note: Dhyan do: 'Muttaqeen' ka matlab sirf 'darne wale' nahi — ye woh log hain jo Allah ki raza ke liye galat cheezon se bachte hain. Taqwa ek active quality hai, passive nahi.

sections.title: Kafiron ki Sifaat
sections.theme: Kufr ki haqeeqat aur unka anjam.
sections.flow: Pehle kafiron ka taaruf, phir unke dil, kaan, aur aankhon par mohar ka zikr, phir azab ka elaan.
sections.summary: Ye do ayat kafiron ke baare mein hain. Unke liye barabar hai — chahe tum unhein darao ya na darao, wo iman nahi laayenge. Allah ne unke dilon aur kaanon par mohar laga di hai aur unki aankhon par parda hai. Unke liye bada azab hai.
sections.study_note: Ye ayat un logon ke baare mein hai jinhone apne ikhtiyar se kufr chuna aur apne dilon ko haq ke liye band kar diya. Allah ki mohar unke apne amal ka natija hai, na ke shuru se unhein gumraah kiya gaya.

sections.title: Munafiqeen ki Sifaat (Pehla Hissa)
sections.theme: Munafiqat ki haqeeqat — do rukhon wale log.
sections.flow: Pehle unka jhoota dawa, phir dhoka dene ki koshish, phir dil ki bimari, phir fasaad, phir bewaqoofi, phir do rukhon wala rawaiya, phir Allah ka mazaak, phir unki tijarat ka nuqsan.
sections.summary: Ye ayat munafiqeen ke baare mein hain — wo log jo zahir mein iman ka dawa karte hain lekin dil se kafir hain. Wo Allah aur momino ko dhoka dene ki koshish karte hain, lekin apne aap ko dhoka de rahe hain. Unke dilon mein bimari hai, wo fasaad phailate hain lekin islaah ka dawa karte hain, wo momino ko bewaqoof kehte hain halanki wo khud bewaqoof hain. Wo momino se mil kar iman ka izhaar karte hain aur apne saathiyon se mil kar mazaak udate hain. Allah unse mazaak karta hai aur unhein unki sarkashi mein bhatakne deta hai.
sections.study_note: Munafiqat ka matlab hai andar kuch aur bahar kuch. Ye iman aur kufr ke darmiyan ek third category hai — ye na mukammal iman hai na khula kufr. Ye sab se khatarnak hai kyunki ye Muslim community ke andar se damage karta hai.

sections.title: Munafiqeen ki Do Misaalein
sections.theme: Aag aur barish ki misaal — munafiqat ki tasveer.
sections.flow: Pehli misaal: aag jalane wala — roshni chali gayi, andhera reh gaya. Dusri misaal: barish, bijli, kadak — har roshni ke saath chalte hain, andhere mein ruk jaate hain.
sections.summary: Allah munafiqeen ki do misaalein deta hai. Pehli misaal: ek shakhs ne aag jalayi, jab usne roshni di, Allah ne unki roshni cheen li aur unhein andheron mein chhor diya. Ye un logon ki tarah hain jo iman ki roshni se faida nahi uthate. Dusri misaal: aasman se barish jisme andhere, bijli aur kadak hai. Wo maut ke darr se apni ungliyan kaanon mein daal lete hain. Jab bijli chamakti hai to chalte hain, jab andhera hota hai to khade reh jaate hain. Ye munafiqeen ki halat hai — wo haq ke saath sirf tab tak chalte hain jab tak unhein faida ho, warna ruk jaate hain.
sections.study_note: Ye do misaalein munafiqat ki mukhtalif shaklein dikhati hain. Pehli misaal mein roshni chali jati hai — yani unka iman aarzi tha. Dusri misaal mein wo roshni ke saath chalte hain lekin andhere mein ruk jaate hain — yani wo sirf tab iman ka saath dete hain jab unhein faida ho.

ayahs.simple: Ye Quran ke huruf muqatta'at hain — kuch letters jo surah ke shuru mein aate hain. Inka matlab sirf Allah jaanta hai. Ye batate hain ke Quran Arabi zaban ke inhi letters se bana hai, lekin phir bhi koi is jaisa nahi bana sakta.
ayahs.deep: Alif Lam Mim Quran ke un 29 surahs mein se hain jo huruf muqatta'at se shuru hoti hain. In letters ka poora matlab Allah ke ilm mein hai — koi insan yaqeen se nahi keh sakta ke inka matlab kya hai. Lekin ek ahem baat ye hai ke ye Arabi zaban ke bunyadi letters hain. Arab log inhi letters se apni zaban banate the. Quran kehta hai: agar tumhein shak hai ke ye Allah ki kitab hai, to inhi letters se tum bhi ek surah bana kar lao. Ye ek challenge hai — aur ye challenge aaj tak koi poora nahi kar saka. Isliye ye letters Quran ki inimitability (i'jaz) ki taraf ishara karte hain.
ayahs.main_message: Quran Allah ki kitab hai — iske letters bhi Arabi hain lekin iska mojiza ye hai ke koi is jaisa nahi bana sakta.

ayahs.transliteration: Allazeena yu'minoona bil-ghaibi wa yuqeemoonas-salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Jo ghaib par iman laate hain, namaz qaim karte hain, aur jo kuch humne unhein diya usme se kharch karte hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them.
ayahs.simple: Ye mominon ki pehli teen sifaat hain. Pehli: wo ghaib par iman laate hain — yani un cheezon par jo aankhon se nahi dikhtin (Allah, farishte, qayamat, etc.). Dusri: wo namaz qaim karte hain — sirf padhte nahi, balki poori tarah ada karte hain. Teesri: jo Allah ne unhein diya usme se kharch karte hain — yani zakat, sadaqah, aur doosron ki madad karte hain.
ayahs.deep: Is ayat mein mominon ki teen sifaat batayi gayi hain. 'Yu'minoona bil-ghaibi' — ghaib par iman. Ghaib ka matlab hai woh cheezein jo insani aankhon se nahi dikhtin — Allah ki zaat, farishte, Jannah, Jahannam, qayamat ka din, etc. Iska matlab ye hai ke momin sirf usi cheez par iman nahi laata jo woh dekh sakta hai — wo Allah ki khabar par yaqeen karta hai. 'Yuqeemoonas-salaata' — namaz qaim karna. Yahan 'qaim' ka matlab sirf padhna nahi — balki poori tarah ada karna, waqt par, khushu ke saath, aur poori zindagi mein namaz ko ek markazi maqam dena. 'Mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon' — jo humne unhein diya usme se kharch karna. Ye zakat, sadaqah, aur har woh kharch hai jo Allah ki raza ke liye kiya jaye. Isme ye bhi shamil hai ke insan apne maal ko sirf apne liye nahi rakhta — wo doosron ke saath baantta hai.
ayahs.main_message: Momin woh hai jo ghaib par iman laaye, namaz qaim kare, aur Allah ke diye hue rizq mein se kharch kare.
ayahs.why_it_matters: Ye teen sifaat momin ki bunyadi pehchaan hain. Agar inme se koi ek bhi nahi hai, to iman adhoora hai. Ye ayat humein batati hai ke iman sirf dil ka yaqeen nahi — ye amal aur kharch mein bhi zahir hota hai.

qa.q: Ghaib par iman ka matlab kya hai?

qa.q: Namaz qaim karna aur namaz padhna mein kya farq hai?
qa.a: Namaz padhna sirf ada karna hai. Namaz qaim karna poori zindagi mein namaz ko markazi maqam dena hai — waqt par, khushu ke saath, aur poori tawajjuh se.

ayahs.transliteration: Wallazeena yu'minoona bimaaa unzila ilaika wa maaa unzila min qablika wa bil-Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
ayahs.roman_urdu: Aur jo iman laate hain uspar jo tum par nazil kiya gaya aur jo tum se pehle nazil kiya gaya, aur Akhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.english_meaning: And who believe in what has been revealed to you and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain.
ayahs.simple: Ye mominon ki do aur sifaat hain. Pehli: wo iman laate hain uspar jo Nabi ﷺ par nazil hua (Quran) aur jo pichhle nabiyon par nazil hua (Tawrah, Injil, Zabur). Dusri: wo Akhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain — sirf iman nahi, balki yaqeen.
ayahs.deep: Is ayat mein mominon ki do aur sifaat batayi gayi hain. 'Yu'minoona bimaaa unzila ilaika' — jo tum par nazil kiya gaya uspar iman. Ye Quran hai. 'Wa maaa unzila min qablika' — jo tum se pehle nazil kiya gaya uspar bhi iman. Ye Tawrah, Injil, Zabur aur doosri kitabein hain. Iska matlab ye hai ke momin sirf Quran par iman nahi laata — wo Allah ki tamam kitabon par iman laata hai. Lekin wo ye bhi jaanta hai ke Quran aakhri aur mukammal kitab hai. 'Wa bil-Aakhirati hum yooqinoon' — Akhirat par yaqeen. Yahan 'yaqeen' ka lafz istemal hua hai, sirf 'iman' nahi. Yaqeen ka matlab hai aisa iman jisme koi shak nahi — jaise insan apni aankhon se dekh raha ho. Ye momin ki Akhirat par mukammal yaqeen ki halat hai.

ayahs.roman_urdu: Ye woh log hain jinhone hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareedi, to unki tijarat ne koi faida nahi diya, aur wo hidayat yafta nahi hue.
ayahs.english_meaning: Those are the ones who have purchased error for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
ayahs.simple: Ye munafiq woh log hain jinhone hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareedi. Unki tijarat ne koi faida nahi diya — wo na dunya mein kaamyab hue na Akhirat mein. Wo hidayat yafta nahi hue.
ayahs.deep: 'Ulaaa'ikal-lazeenash-tarawud-dalaalata bil-hudaa' — ye woh log hain jinhone hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareedi. Ye ek tijarat ki misaal hai — jaisa koi cheez khareedta hai. Unhonne apni hidayat ko gumraahi se badal diya. 'Famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum' — to unki tijarat ne koi faida nahi diya. Ye tijarat ghate ka sauda thi. 'Wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen' — aur wo hidayat yafta nahi hue. Is ayat mein munafiqeen ki halat ek tijarat ki misaal se batayi gayi hai. Unhonne apni hidayat — jo unhe mili thi — ko gumraahi se badal diya. Ye sab se bada nuqsan hai. Unki tijarat na dunya mein kaamyab hui na Akhirat mein.
ayahs.main_message: Munafiq woh hain jinhone hidayat ke badle gumraahi khareedi — unki tijarat ghate ka sauda thi.
ayahs.why_it_matters: Ye ayat humein batati hai ke hidayat ek daulat hai — ise khona sab se bada nuqsan hai. Jo log hidayat ke badle gumraahi chunte hain, wo dono jahon mein khasare mein hain.

ayahs.transliteration: Aw kasayyibim minas-samaaa'i feehi zulumaatunw wa ra'dunw wa barq; yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim minas-sawaa'iqi hazaral-mawt; wallaahu muheetum bil-kaafireen

ayahs.deep: 'Aw kasayyibim minas-samaaa'i' — ya jaise aasman se barish. 'Feehi zulumaatunw wa ra'dunw wa barq' — jisme andhere, kadak, aur bijli hai. 'Wallaahu muheetum bil-kaafireen' — aur Allah kafiron ko gherne wala hai. Is misaal mein munafiqeen ki halat ek toofani barish ki tarah batayi gayi hai.
